verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an official MCP server at developers.pomelo.la/mcp with Cursor install steps (one-click or manual), so an agent can connect to it. However, its documented tools only search API endpoints and generate request code samples. They do not operate on the Pomelo account (users, cards, transactions), so the server is a documentation helper rather than an operational agent interface. missing for 10: MCP tools that execute real Pomelo API operations, setup docs for clients beyond Cursor, auth/scope documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Para instalar nuestro MCP en Cursor, puedes hacer clic en el botón a continuación o seguir los pasos manualmente.
Devuelve los endpoints que coincidan con una consulta específica en español o inglés.

official MCP server documented at https://developers.pomelo.la/mcp
